cactus.lore.rare: Fires one spine at anyone who calls it cute. It never misses, and it never says sorry.
cactus.lore.epic: Grew so many arms that the family started hanging their coats on it. Every coat in the house now has tiny holes.
cactus.lore.legendary: Waited a hundred years to bloom, then did it the one week its owner was on holiday. The neighbour has the only photo.

x_recycling_box.lore.epic: Rattled its bottles so loudly on bin night that the bin lorry came a day early, just to make it stop.
x_recycling_box.lore.legendary: Sorted a whole town's rubbish in one night, then put the town hall in the paper bin because it was mostly forms.

x_recycling_crate.lore.rare: Clinks its bottles in the exact tune of the ice cream van, so every child on the street runs out with money.
x_recycling_crate.lore.epic: Tumbled down the hill in a gale, playing a tune on its bottles all the way. The brass band has asked for the music.
x_recycling_crate.lore.legendary: Recycled itself into a brand-new crate, then put the old one out for collection. Even the bin lorry cannot tell which one is which.

flower.lore.common: Makes everyone with hay fever sneeze at the exact moment they say how pretty it is.
flower.lore.rare: Changes colour to match whoever stands next to it, so the bride vanished from every wedding photo.
flower.lore.epic: Bloomed in the middle of the football pitch, and the referee would not let anyone tread on it. The match was played round it.
flower.lore.legendary: Pollinated every garden in the country with one sneeze. The bees have gone on strike, saying it is doing their job.

i_mountain_tent.lore.rare: Picks up its pegs in the night and moves to the comfiest spot, so its campers wake up in someone else's pitch.
i_mountain_tent.lore.legendary: Climbed the mountain on its own in the night, pegs and all. The climbers reached the top and found it had made tea.

i_paddlewheel.lore.rare: Spins backwards whenever a passenger says they are in a hurry. The ferry has never once been on time.
i_paddlewheel.lore.epic: Churned so hard that it pushed the whole river back upstream. The salmon had to do their journey twice.
i_paddlewheel.lore.legendary: Paddled a river steamer across the open sea without noticing it had left the river. The captain says it was a shortcut.

x_apron.lore.rare: Throws every splash it catches straight back at the cook. The chef now wears swimming goggles to make soup.
x_apron.lore.epic: Shook out its pocket at the bake sale, and the hall disappeared under flour. The caretaker had to use a snow shovel.
x_apron.lore.legendary: Cooked a whole wedding feast by itself while its owner had a nap. It still got the blame for the one burnt sausage.

x_apron_dress.lore.common: Has a big bow at the back that unties itself whenever its wearer is carrying something hot.
x_apron_dress.lore.uncommon: Blends into the flowery kitchen wallpaper so well that nobody can find the cook at dinner time.
x_apron_dress.lore.rare: Ties its own strings to anything nearby, so its wearer keeps getting attached to the fence.
x_apron_dress.lore.epic: Spun round once at the barn dance, and every bow in the hall untied itself. The band had to stop and help.
x_apron_dress.lore.legendary: Picked every strawberry in the county into its front pocket in one morning. The jam factory now delivers straight to it.

x_life_jacket.lore.rare: Is so buoyant that it floats on dry land, and its wearer has to be tied to the bench like a balloon.
x_life_jacket.lore.epic: Inflated so fast on the lake that it lifted the canoe instructor clean out of the water. He has asked for a slower one.
x_life_jacket.lore.legendary: Floated its sleeping wearer across the sea and back in one night. He woke on the same beach, very confused by his tan.

x_bird_feeder.lore.rare: Lets in only birds with good manners. The pigeons now queue in a polite line, and the squirrel has been barred.
x_bird_feeder.lore.epic: Fed so many birds one morning that the flock lifted the garden shed and dropped it in the park.
x_bird_feeder.lore.legendary: Taught a robin to ring the doorbell when the seed runs out. Now every bird in the street rings it at six in the morning.

x_birdhouse.lore.uncommon: Measures every bird at the door, and turns away anyone a single feather too wide.
x_birdhouse.lore.rare: Chirps so convincingly that the cat sits underneath it for hours. There has never been a bird inside.
x_birdhouse.lore.epic: Was moved into by so many birds that it grew a second floor overnight. The blue tits complain about the noise upstairs.
x_birdhouse.lore.legendary: Built itself an extension so big that two owls, a heron and the postman now live in it. The postman has never been happier.

x_letterbox_flap.lore.uncommon: Whistles a cold draught down the hall all winter, always during the quietest part of the film.
x_letterbox_flap.lore.epic: Snapped shut on the postman's sleeve and would not let go until he read out every letter. The street now knows far too much.
x_letterbox_flap.lore.legendary: Ate a whole sack of junk mail in one bite, then posted it back to the senders. Not one flyer has arrived in town since.

mushroom.lore.legendary: Grew a fairy ring so wide that it went round the whole town. Everyone inside it keeps losing exactly one sock.

x_flower_pot_saucer.lore.legendary: Caught every drip from a leaking roof all winter, then poured it back on the plant in one go. The plant has moved out.

x_planter.lore.rare: Grows whatever the neighbours planted instead, so the family keeps picking next door's courgettes.
x_planter.lore.epic: Grew a tomato so heavy that the patio tipped over, and the barbecue slid into the pond.
x_planter.lore.legendary: Grew a pumpkin so big in one window box that the wall came down to get it in. The family now live in a three-bed pumpkin.

rose.lore.rare: Makes anyone who sniffs it fall in love with the nearest object. The gardener now writes poems to his wheelbarrow.
rose.lore.epic: Grew over the front door so thickly in one night that the family used the cat flap for a week.
rose.lore.legendary: Grew a hedge so thick round a castle that everyone inside dozed off for a week. The postman is still waiting at the gate.

i_bobsled.lore.rare: Goes so fast that it finishes the run before its crew have finished climbing in.
i_bobsled.lore.legendary: Slid so fast that it went round the track and back up the mountain. The ski lift has been made redundant.

i_dogsled.lore.rare: Steers itself towards the nearest sausage shop, whichever way its driver shouts.
i_dogsled.lore.epic: Was pulled so hard that it skimmed across the frozen lake, the river and a car park. The dogs only stopped for a squirrel.
i_dogsled.lore.legendary: Pulled its team all the way to the North Pole, then turned straight round because one dog had forgotten its ball.

x_electric_skateboard.lore.rare: Hears the word 'go' in any sentence and leaves. Nobody in the house can say 'good morning' any more.
x_electric_skateboard.lore.epic: Ran out of battery on the high street, so it plugged itself into the town clock. The whole town is now ten minutes slow.
x_electric_skateboard.lore.legendary: Charged itself from a thunderstorm and rode to the seaside and back before breakfast. Its owner found sand in the wheels.

x_hoverboard.lore.legendary: Hovered so high one morning that its rider ate breakfast on the roof. The pigeons now expect toast every day.

x_jet_ski.lore.uncommon: Sprays a tail of water over the one person on the beach who had managed to stay dry.
x_jet_ski.lore.rare: Drives on anything wet, so it keeps turning up in the car wash and the paddling pool.
x_jet_ski.lore.epic: Jumped a wave so high that it landed on the pier and joined the ice cream queue as if nothing had happened.
x_jet_ski.lore.legendary: Raced a pod of dolphins right across the ocean and lost. The dolphins have asked for a rematch on land.

x_ski.lore.rare: Skis uphill whenever its skier wants to go down. The instructor calls it character building.
x_ski.lore.epic: Skied straight through the mountain cafe and out of the other side, taking a plate of chips with it.

x_sled.lore.rare: Slides on anything, not just snow. It has been down the stairs, the drive and, once, the school roof.
x_sled.lore.epic: Slid down the hill, across the village green and in through the bakery door. It came out with a bun stuck on its front.
x_sled.lore.legendary: Hit the bump at the bottom so hard that it flew over the town and landed on the next hill. It wants to go again.

x_snowboard.lore.epic: Jumped so high out of the half-pipe that it landed on the cafe roof and slid in through the chimney.
x_snowboard.lore.legendary: Spun so many times in one jump that it did not come down until the next morning. Its rider had breakfast in the air.

x_surfboard.lore.rare: Hears a wave coming from miles away, so it drags its surfer out of bed at four in the morning.
x_surfboard.lore.epic: Caught a wave so big that it surfed through the seafront hotel and out of the back door into the car park.
x_surfboard.lore.legendary: Rode one wave all the way round the world and arrived back on the same beach. Its surfer was very late for tea.

x_air_mattress.lore.rare: Squeaks every time its sleeper rolls over, so the whole tent thinks there is a duck inside.
x_air_mattress.lore.epic: Was pumped up so hard that it lifted the tent off the ground, and the campers woke up floating over the next field.
x_air_mattress.lore.legendary: Floated a sleeping holidaymaker all the way to a tiny island. He liked it so much that he opened a cafe there.

x_camping_mattress.lore.epic: Sprang open so hard in the scout hut that it rolled the scout leader up inside it. He slept surprisingly well.
x_camping_mattress.lore.legendary: Rolled itself up so tightly one morning that it fitted in a pencil case. It has refused to unroll ever since.

x_sleeping_mat.lore.rare: Reflects the campfire so well that it toasts its sleeper's back like a crumpet.
x_sleeping_mat.lore.epic: Blew away in the night with its camper still asleep on it. He woke up on the village green, next to the duck pond.
x_sleeping_mat.lore.legendary: Kept its sleeper so comfy on a mountain that he slept through the whole winter like a bear.

sunflower.lore.rare: Turns to stare at anyone eating sunflower seeds. Nobody in the garden can finish a snack.
sunflower.lore.epic: Turned to follow the sun so fast that it spun the scarecrow round and round all afternoon.
sunflower.lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it blocked the sunset for the whole valley. Evenings there now start at lunchtime.

x_compost_bin.lore.epic: Rotted so fast one summer that the lid floated off on the smell, and the neighbours bought clothes pegs for their noses.
x_compost_bin.lore.legendary: Turned a whole year of the town's peelings into one hill. The council put a bench on top and called it a view.

x_pedal_bin.lore.rare: Knows when you are about to throw away something useful, and keeps its lid shut until you change your mind.
x_pedal_bin.lore.legendary: Opened its lid so fast that it fired a banana skin over the roof. It landed in a bin two streets away.

x_sanitary_bin.lore.epic: Kept its corner so tidy that the cleaners gave it a name badge and asked it to train the new mop.
x_sanitary_bin.lore.legendary: Was so discreet that the whole shopping centre forgot it existed, until it politely asked for a holiday.

x_sharps_bin.lore.epic: Shut its lid so loudly at the flu clinic that everyone forgot to be nervous about their jab.
x_sharps_bin.lore.legendary: Is so bright yellow that the air ambulance uses it to find the hospital roof. Nobody is allowed to move it.

x_waste_paper_basket.lore.rare: Uncrumples every paper ball overnight, so the office arrives to find all its bad ideas flat on the desks.
x_waste_paper_basket.lore.epic: Swallowed the boss's important letter with a burp, and the whole office spent the afternoon reading rubbish.
x_waste_paper_basket.lore.legendary: Caught a paper ball thrown from the other side of the river. A basketball team has asked it to stand under their hoop.

x_wheelie_bin.lore.rare: Wheels itself to the kerb on bin day but never comes back. It is found streets away, chatting to other bins.
x_wheelie_bin.lore.legendary: Rolled itself onto the bin lorry, drove it round the town and did the whole collection. The crew had a lie-in.

tulip.lore.epic: Shut every tulip in the park at lunchtime, and the bees had to queue outside like customers at a closed shop.
tulip.lore.legendary: Grew a bulb so precious that the town swapped it for a brand-new bridge. The bridge is lovely, but it keeps flowering.

x_sprinkler.lore.rare: Switches itself on the moment someone sits in a deckchair, then pretends to be broken.
x_sprinkler.lore.legendary: Spun so fast on the hottest day that it lifted off and watered the next village too. They sent it a postcard.

x_sprinkler_head.lore.legendary: Popped up in the middle of the cricket final and soaked the bowler mid-run. The umpire gave the batter six runs for it.

x_acorn_cap.lore.rare: Fits on any fingertip and will not come off, so its finder spends the afternoon waving like a puppet.
x_acorn_cap.lore.epic: Was blown across the park in one gust and landed on every pigeon's head. The pigeons refuse to take them off.
x_acorn_cap.lore.legendary: Whistled so loudly through one child's thumbs that every dog in the county came running and sat down to wait for orders.

x_air_plant.lore.rare: Floats off its shelf when nobody is looking and hangs from the ceiling, looking innocent.
x_air_plant.lore.epic: Drifted out of the window and floated round the town for a week, having a quick bath in every fountain.
x_air_plant.lore.legendary: Breathed in so hard that it soaked up a whole fog bank and left the harbour sparkling. The lighthouse has nothing to do.

x_aloe_vera.lore.rare: Cools anything it touches, so the tea goes cold and the toast goes floppy.
x_aloe_vera.lore.epic: Oozed so much gel in the heatwave that the patio became a slide. The cat has been going round on it since Tuesday.
x_aloe_vera.lore.legendary: Soothed a sunburn on the Sun itself. The Sun now wears a little hat every summer.

x_bamboo.lore.rare: Is so tasty to pandas that the zoo keeps it behind glass, and the pandas press their noses on it all day.
x_bamboo.lore.legendary: Bent right down in a typhoon and flicked a fishing boat back into the harbour like a pea.

x_begonia.lore.rare: Grows leaves shaped like elephant ears and uses them to listen in on every phone call in the house.
x_begonia.lore.epic: Bloomed so pink that the flamingos at the zoo escaped to stand next to its window box.
x_begonia.lore.legendary: Bloomed so hard all year that it forgot to stop for winter, and the snow had to fall round it.

x_bonsai_tree_plant.lore.rare: Makes everyone who looks at it whisper, so the house goes silent whenever it is in the room.
x_bonsai_tree_plant.lore.epic: Grew a tiny forest on its pot, with a tiny storm that soaked the windowsill and blew the curtains about.
x_bonsai_tree_plant.lore.legendary: Shrank a whole mountain to fit in its pot, snowy top and all. Climbers now climb it on the windowsill in an afternoon.

x_candy_cane.lore.rare: Hooks itself onto anything that walks past, and was last seen riding round on the cat's collar.
x_candy_cane.lore.epic: Hooked a passing kite at the winter fair and flew the whole sweet stall into the next field.
x_candy_cane.lore.legendary: Hooked the Moon on a cold night and pulled it down for a lick. The Moon still has a minty stripe.

x_cane.lore.rare: Hooks anything its owner points at, from a dropped glove to a pigeon's dinner.
x_cane.lore.epic: Tapped such a catchy rhythm on the pavement that the whole bus queue started tap dancing.
x_cane.lore.legendary: Hooked a runaway bus by its back bumper and held it until the driver came back. Its owner never even put down his paper.

x_canopy_tent.lore.epic: Folded up so suddenly at the market that it packed away the cake stall, the cakes and the cake seller.
x_canopy_tent.lore.legendary: Stayed up so long at the summer fair that the post office gave it its own postcode.

x_carnation.lore.epic: Was dyed blue for a wedding and drank so much dye that the vase, the table and the best man all turned blue.
x_carnation.lore.legendary: Smelled so strongly of cloves that the whole wedding sneezed through the vows. The couple got married twice to be safe.

x_cherry_blossom.lore.rare: Bursts into bloom whenever a camera points at it, then drops every petal the moment the camera goes away.
x_cherry_blossom.lore.epic: Blossomed so thickly over the bus stop that the bus drove straight past it. Half the town was late for work.
x_cherry_blossom.lore.legendary: Bloomed so beautifully that the whole city took the day off to look. The office computers are still waiting.

x_chrysanthemum.lore.rare: Fires out a pompom of petals whenever it is startled, so the cat walks round it on tiptoe.
x_chrysanthemum.lore.epic: Grew a pompom so huge that the school borrowed it as a football for a whole term.
x_chrysanthemum.lore.legendary: Opened a thousand petals at once and blew the roof off the greenhouse like a party popper.

x_clover.lore.rare: Gives a little luck to whoever finds it, but only little: everyone who picks it finds a coin and loses a sock.
x_clover.lore.epic: Spread across the bowling green in one night, and every bowl now rolls in curly lines.
x_clover.lore.legendary: Grew one clover with a hundred leaves. It is so lucky that it keeps winning raffles it never entered.

x_cricket_stumps.lore.rare: Steps a tiny bit to the left whenever the ball is coming, so nobody in the village can get bowled out.
x_cricket_stumps.lore.epic: Was hit so hard that its bails flew over the pavilion and into the umpire's sandwich. Play stopped for an argument.
x_cricket_stumps.lore.legendary: Stood unbeaten for a whole summer while the bowlers retired one by one. The last one now runs the tea shop.

x_crutch.lore.rare: Grips the ground so firmly that its user can stand still in a gale while everyone else blows down the street.
x_crutch.lore.epic: Swung its user so fast down the hospital corridor that the porter with the tea trolley had to leap aside.
x_crutch.lore.legendary: Swung its user over the river in one leap, and the bridge has felt rather useless ever since.

x_daffodil.lore.rare: Toots its trumpet at sunrise, so the whole street wakes up one minute before every alarm clock.
x_daffodil.lore.epic: Came up so early that it pushed through the snowman's hat, and the snowman looked surprised all week.
x_daffodil.lore.legendary: Bloomed so early one year that spring got the date wrong and turned up in January. Winter is still sulking.

x_dandelion.lore.rare: Grants a tiny wish to every child who blows it, but always the wrong one. Somebody asked for a puppy and got a puddle.
x_dandelion.lore.epic: Blew so many seeds through the open window that the classroom had grown a lawn by home time.
x_dandelion.lore.legendary: Blew one seed so far that it landed on top of the highest mountain and grew there. The climbers now wave at it.

x_fence.lore.rare: Grows a new panel every night, so the garden is a little smaller each morning.
x_fence.lore.legendary: Was painted so many times that it is now mostly paint, and it stands up on its own without any posts.

x_fern_frond.lore.rare: Unrolls its fronds across the path overnight, so the morning jogger trips over a green carpet.
x_fern_frond.lore.epic: Spread through the wood in one wet week, and the orienteering club are still finding their way out.
x_fern_frond.lore.legendary: Is so old that it still remembers the dinosaurs, and tells off the chickens for forgetting where they came from.

x_ficus.lore.rare: Leans towards whoever is talking about it, so the whole office has learned to whisper nice things.
x_ficus.lore.epic: Shed every leaf on the morning of the big meeting, and the boss gave his talk standing in a pile.
x_ficus.lore.legendary: Was moved to a new desk once and sulked so hard that the whole company moved back to the old building.

x_fishing_reel.lore.rare: Reels so fast that it has pulled in fish, a duck and once a canoe with a very surprised man in it.
x_fishing_reel.lore.epic: Tangled its line right round the lake, and the swans spent the afternoon untying each other.
x_fishing_reel.lore.legendary: Reeled in the far bank of the lake by mistake. The lake is now much smaller, and the fish are not pleased.

x_fishing_rod.lore.rare: Catches fish that promise to tell it where the bigger ones are. The fish are very good at fibbing.
x_fishing_rod.lore.epic: Cast so far that it hooked a sausage off a barbecue on the other bank. The owner still wants it back.

x_flower_bouquet.lore.rare: Makes whoever is holding it sneeze all over the person they were about to give it to.
x_flower_bouquet.lore.legendary: Smelled so good that every bee in the county followed the delivery van. The driver had to deliver the bees as well.

x_football_goal.lore.rare: Shuffles a little wider whenever the home team shoots, and a little narrower for the visitors.

x_garland.lore.rare: Ties itself round anyone who walks underneath, so the guest of honour arrives looking like a flowerbed.
x_garland.lore.epic: Was strung across the street so low that the double-decker bus drove off wearing it.
x_garland.lore.legendary: Was made so long that it joined two villages together. They now argue every week about whose turn it is to water it.

x_gate.lore.rare: Swings shut behind every walker but opens again for the cows. The farmer suspects a plot.
x_gate.lore.legendary: Swung open so hard in a storm that it let the whole countryside in. There is now a hill in the back garden.

x_gazebo.lore.rare: Catches every balloon that floats away from a party and keeps them in its roof like a nest.
x_gazebo.lore.epic: Blew over two fences in a summer storm and landed over next door's barbecue, which carried on regardless.
x_gazebo.lore.legendary: Hosted a garden party that never ended. Last summer's guests are still there, and they have built a pond.

x_geranium.lore.rare: Glows so red in the front window that drivers keep stopping outside, thinking it is a traffic light.
x_geranium.lore.epic: Grew from one cutting into so many plants that the window boxes ran out and it moved into the bath.
x_geranium.lore.legendary: Made the whole town take up gardening just to keep up with it. The high street now sells nothing but compost.

x_grass.lore.epic: Grew so long over one holiday that the family lost the lawnmower in it, and found a tortoise that was not theirs.
x_grass.lore.legendary: Grew back so stubbornly that the lawnmower handed in its notice.

x_hibiscus.lore.rare: Makes anyone standing near it talk about their holidays, and they cannot stop.
x_hibiscus.lore.epic: Bloomed so big at the garden party that a guest wore it as a sun hat, and nobody could find her all afternoon.
x_hibiscus.lore.legendary: Bloomed so brightly that the grey sky over town turned blue to match, and it has stayed that way all summer.

x_hiking_pole.lore.rare: Finds the one bog on the hill and plants itself in it, so its hiker always ends up with one wet boot.
x_hiking_pole.lore.epic: Pole-vaulted its hiker over the stream, the stile and one very startled sheep in a single jump.
x_hiking_pole.lore.legendary: Poked the top of the mountain so hard that it grew a little taller. Every map in the country had to be reprinted.

x_hurdle.lore.legendary: Stood back up so fast after being knocked over that it tripped the winner on the way back. The race is being rerun.

x_hydrangea.lore.rare: Grows flower heads so heavy that they lean on the fence and push it into next door's garden.
x_hydrangea.lore.epic: Turned so blue one summer that the seagulls kept diving into it, thinking it was the sea.
x_hydrangea.lore.legendary: Changes colour every hour on the hour, so the whole village now sets its clocks by it.

x_iris.lore.rare: Watches everyone through its eye-shaped petals, so the frogs refuse to croak while it is looking.
x_iris.lore.epic: Grew so thick round the pond that the ducks had to apply for a gate.
x_iris.lore.legendary: Stared at a rain cloud until it turned into a rainbow, and now the rainbow follows it round the garden.

x_ivy.lore.rare: Grows into the shape of a face on the wall and pulls faces at the neighbours.
x_ivy.lore.legendary: Held up a crumbling castle for so long that the stones retired. The ivy is now the castle.

x_jade_plant.lore.rare: Grows a coin-shaped leaf every time someone finds money down the sofa, and keeps the coin.
x_jade_plant.lore.legendary: Grew so many coin-shaped leaves that the corner shop's till started taking them instead of money.

x_jasmine.lore.rare: Sends its scent through the keyhole at night, so everyone dreams about holidays and wakes up grumpy.
x_jasmine.lore.epic: Smelled so sweet one summer night that every moth in the county came, and the street lights disappeared under them.
x_jasmine.lore.legendary: Climbed the town clock and wound itself round the hands, so the whole town is now always on time for tea.

x_lavender.lore.rare: Calms anyone who sniffs it, even the angriest dog on the street, who rolls over to have its tummy tickled.
x_lavender.lore.epic: Was hung up to dry in the barn, and the smell knocked the farm cat out until Thursday.
x_lavender.lore.legendary: Made a thunderstorm so relaxed that it forgot to rain and lay down on the hills for a nap.

x_leaf.lore.rare: Falls only on freshly swept paths, and it waits for the broom to be put away first.
x_leaf.lore.epic: Blew across the football pitch in one gust and covered the goal so well that nobody could score all afternoon.
x_leaf.lore.legendary: Held on to its branch so stubbornly that autumn gave up and skipped straight to spring.

x_lichen.lore.rare: Grows a little map on every rock, and the hikers keep following it the wrong way.
x_lichen.lore.epic: Covered the town statue so completely that the town forgot who it was and renamed it Mister Yellow.
x_lichen.lore.legendary: Took a thousand years to cover one boulder, then rolled it down the hill to start on a fresh one.

x_lily_flower.lore.rare: Opens with a pop so loud at night that the whole house thinks someone is at the door.
x_lily_flower.lore.epic: Dropped so much pollen in the new living room that the white sofa is now orange, and so is the dog.
x_lily_flower.lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that the perfume shop in town closed down, saying it could not compete.

x_lotus.lore.rare: Stays spotless in any mud, so the frogs use it to wipe their feet before going home.
x_lotus.lore.epic: Opened so many flowers at once that the pond rose and the goldfish had to move up a floor.
x_lotus.lore.legendary: Bloomed out of a muddy puddle in the car park and stayed so clean that the car wash asked for its secret.

x_magnolia.lore.rare: Blooms before it has any leaves, so it spends every spring explaining to the neighbours that it is not cold.
x_magnolia.lore.epic: Dropped so many petals on the school field that sports day was run on a pink carpet, very slowly.
x_magnolia.lore.legendary: Dropped a single petal so big that the family used it as a sledge for the rest of the spring.

x_maple_leaf.lore.rare: Sticks to anything sweet, so every autumn pancake arrives with a leaf on top.
x_maple_leaf.lore.epic: Turned so red that the bull in the next field charged the tree all afternoon.

x_marigold.lore.rare: Glows so orange that the snails think it is sunset and go to bed early.
x_marigold.lore.epic: Smelled so strong that every slug packed up and moved next door in one long silver line.
x_marigold.lore.legendary: Glowed so orange in a power cut that the whole street read its bedtime stories by it.

x_metal_detector.lore.rare: Beeps at every buckle and zip on the beach, so sunbathers keep getting politely dug round.
x_metal_detector.lore.epic: Beeped so loudly under the pier that the lifeguards dug the whole beach up. It was a ring pull.
x_metal_detector.lore.legendary: Found a whole sunken ship under the beach, then lost interest because there were no bottle caps on it.

x_money_tree.lore.rare: Grows a new leaf every time someone says money does not grow on trees, just to prove a point.
x_money_tree.lore.epic: Rustled so hopefully in the bank window that a queue formed outside, waiting for it to drop something.
x_money_tree.lore.legendary: Finally grew one coin on its top branch. It was a chocolate one, and the tree has never been prouder.

x_monstera.lore.epic: Grew a leaf so big that the family used it as a tablecloth for Sunday lunch, and it kept the leftovers.

x_moss.lore.legendary: Grew so soft on the town hall steps that the council took the benches away. Nobody has stood up since.

x_oar.lore.rare: Rows backwards whenever the rower faces forwards, so every trip on the lake starts with an argument.
x_oar.lore.epic: Splashed so hard in one stroke that it emptied half the boating lake into the cafe.
x_oar.lore.legendary: Rowed so hard that it pulled the island closer to the shore. The ferry now takes two minutes.

x_orchid_plant.lore.epic: Sent its silvery roots across the windowsill and drank the goldfish bowl dry. The goldfish now lives in the teapot.
x_orchid_plant.lore.legendary: Was so fussy that it trained its owners to move house whenever it wanted a better windowsill.

x_paddle.lore.rare: Paddles towards every waterfall it hears, so the kayak club keep a rope tied to its handle.
x_paddle.lore.epic: Paddled so fast that the kayak went up the waterfall instead of down it.
x_paddle.lore.legendary: Paddled so fast that the kayak beat the speedboat, the ferry and the weather forecast to the island.

x_pansy.lore.rare: Pulls such cheeky faces that the gnome in the next pot has turned round to face the wall.
x_pansy.lore.epic: Grinned out of every window box on the high street until the grumpiest shopkeeper started giving out free sweets.
x_pansy.lore.legendary: Survived a winter so cold that the snowman came to it for advice. It told him to wear a scarf.

x_party_hat.lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it the birthday person, so every guest gets sung to and the real birthday boy sulks.
x_party_hat.lore.epic: Pinged its elastic so hard that it fired itself through the cake and into the trifle.
x_party_hat.lore.legendary: Turned up at every birthday party in town on the same day, uninvited, and still got the first slice each time.

x_peace_lily.lore.rare: Raises one white flower like a flag whenever an argument starts, and everyone has to stop and say sorry.
x_peace_lily.lore.epic: Drooped so dramatically during the office inspection that the inspector watered it and forgot to inspect anything.
x_peace_lily.lore.legendary: Ended a very old argument between two villages by waving one white flower at exactly the right moment.

x_peony.lore.epic: Opened with such a whoosh in June that it blew the ants off, and they landed in the neighbour's jam.
x_peony.lore.legendary: Opened a flower so big that the school held its assembly under it on a rainy day.

x_petunia.lore.rare: Creeps out of its basket along the shop sign, so the bakery now spells BAKERY in petals.
x_petunia.lore.epic: Overflowed its basket so much that the lamp post holding it is now officially a hedge.
x_petunia.lore.legendary: Trailed from a top-floor window box all the way down to the river, and the boats now tie up to it.

x_pine_cone.lore.rare: Drops on whoever says it is a lovely day for a walk. It never misses.
x_pine_cone.lore.epic: Fell on the tent in the night so loudly that the whole campsite thought a bear had arrived.
x_pine_cone.lore.legendary: Opened so wide one dry summer that it dropped a seed which had grown into a whole forest by autumn.

x_poppy.lore.rare: Pops up in any freshly dug patch, so the builders keep finding red flowers in the new driveway.
x_poppy.lore.epic: Shook its pepper-pot pod so hard over the picnic that every sandwich came out seasoned.
x_poppy.lore.legendary: Scattered one pod of seeds along the railway line, and the train drivers keep stopping to take photos.

x_pothos.lore.rare: Grows towards the wifi router and wraps itself round it, so the internet only works for plants.
x_pothos.lore.legendary: Trailed out of the window, down the street and into the library, where it now has its own reading card.

x_reed.lore.rare: Whistles when the wind blows across it, and the ducks line up thinking it is feeding time.
x_reed.lore.epic: Grew so thick round the lake that the fishing club cut a door in it, and the swans lock it at night.
x_reed.lore.legendary: Whistled such a catchy tune in the wind that the frogs formed a band and went on tour.

x_rubber_plant.lore.rare: Bounces anything that lands on it back where it came from, including the cat.
x_rubber_plant.lore.epic: Grew one leaf so shiny that the sunrise bounced off it and woke the whole street at dawn.
x_rubber_plant.lore.legendary: Stretched so tall one spring that it pushed the roof up and gave the family a free attic.

x_seed_pod.lore.rare: Rattles like a maraca in the wind, and the garden has a little dance every breezy evening.
x_seed_pod.lore.epic: Popped so hard in the heat that it fired seeds through the greenhouse glass like tiny marbles.
x_seed_pod.lore.legendary: Burst with such a bang that seeds landed on every roof in town. The town now has green roofs.

x_ski_pole.lore.rare: Points at whatever its skier is looking at, so they keep skiing straight towards the cafe.
x_ski_pole.lore.epic: Pushed off so hard on the flat bit that its skier shot past the finish, the car park and the bus stop.
x_ski_pole.lore.legendary: Pushed its skier so hard that they went up the next mountain and down the other side, winning two races at once.

x_snake_plant.lore.rare: Stands so still and upright in the hall that burglars think it is a guard and tiptoe away.
x_snake_plant.lore.epic: Survived a whole term in a student flat on nothing but cold tea, and is now the healthiest thing in it.
x_snake_plant.lore.legendary: Was forgotten in a cupboard for a whole year and came out taller. It now gives the other plants advice.

x_spider_plant.lore.rare: Lowers its babies on long stems like spiders on threads, and the guests scream every time.
x_spider_plant.lore.epic: Dangled so many babies from the top shelf that the stairs became a curtain, and the cat moved in with the neighbours.
x_spider_plant.lore.legendary: Lowered one baby out of a high window so far that it took root in the pavement and grew into a tree.

x_tennis_net.lore.rare: Hums when a ball is about to hit it, so everyone ducks and the ball sails over.
x_tennis_net.lore.epic: Caught a serve so hard that it fired the ball back over the stands and into the strawberries.
x_tennis_net.lore.legendary: Stretched so long one summer that a match was played across two towns, and the ball needed a passport.

x_tent.lore.legendary: Zipped itself shut so tightly in a storm that it floated down the river with its campers inside, still dry.

x_thistle.lore.epic: Puffed so much fluff into the school playground that the children had a snowball fight in July.
x_thistle.lore.legendary: Guarded its field so fiercely that a whole herd of cows turned round and went to eat someone else's grass.

x_venus_flytrap.lore.rare: Snaps at anything that buzzes, including the doorbell, the phone and the hairdryer.
x_venus_flytrap.lore.epic: Snapped up every fly at the barbecue, then waited by the table for the ketchup.
x_venus_flytrap.lore.legendary: Snapped shut on a passing toy drone and kept it as a pet. It flies it round the windowsill every morning.

x_vine.lore.rare: Wraps its tendrils round anything left on the patio overnight, so the bicycle now belongs to the vine.
x_vine.lore.legendary: Climbed the new house so fast that it reached the roof before the builders, and now holds the tiles on.

x_violet.lore.rare: Hides its scent the moment you sniff it, then lets it out again as soon as you walk away.
x_violet.lore.epic: Spread so thickly over the woodland path that the walkers had to hop home between them like stepping stones.
x_violet.lore.legendary: Hid so well that a whole search party went out to find it and came back with two lost dogs and a missing bicycle.

x_volleyball_net.lore.rare: Walks up the beach with the tide, so every match starts in a different place.
x_volleyball_net.lore.legendary: Blocked a spike so hard that the ball went out to sea, and a fishing boat sent it back a week later.

x_walking_stick.lore.uncommon: Points out every interesting thing on the walk, so a ten-minute stroll takes all afternoon.
x_walking_stick.lore.rare: Taps so steadily that its walker's feet copy it, and they keep marching even after the walk is over.
x_walking_stick.lore.epic: Found a short cut that took the whole rambling club through a farmyard, a bakery and somebody's kitchen.
x_walking_stick.lore.legendary: Was stuck in the ground for a rest and grew into a whole tree. Its owner now walks with the tree's grandchild.

x_water_lily.lore.rare: Closes its flower round any frog that falls asleep inside, then lets it out at lunchtime with a little pop.
x_water_lily.lore.legendary: Grew a pad so big that the village held its summer fete on it. Only the tombola sank.

x_wildflower.lore.rare: Seeds itself in every crack in the road, so the grey car park is now covered in polka dots.
x_wildflower.lore.epic: Took over the roundabout so thoroughly that drivers now go round it twice just to look.
x_wildflower.lore.legendary: Grew a meadow on the roof of the number nine bus, and the bus now has its own bees.

x_wreath.lore.common: Swings round to face the wrong way every time the door opens, so visitors keep knocking on the wall.
x_wreath.lore.rare: Pricks the knuckles of every visitor who knocks, so everyone has started using the bell.
x_wreath.lore.epic: Rolled off the front door in a gale and bowled down the high street like a hoop, collecting hats.
x_wreath.lore.legendary: Was so welcoming that it invited a passing parade inside, and the band is still in the living room.
